baseline.formatHashAlgorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON: recursively sort object keys, preserve array order, and use JSON.stringify-compatible scalar encoding.

affectedNodes.required: Keep semantic candidate verification separate from measured trial receipts; validate independent evaluator evidence under a public trust anchor distinct from local WAL signing.
Freeze exact proposal and target prestate/output before trial; reject semantic-only and legacy summary promotion; apply exact frozen bytes only after measured eligibility and CAS.

Canonical content remains ordinary access. Only internally resolved, named trial sessions may read frozen proposal bytes; persist budget before exposure and derive unique use/lift from authenticated replay.
Keep existing tools and public methods unchanged; add only a narrow authenticated trial entry point after protected descriptor and evaluator artifact transport are approved and provisioned.
Consume authenticated complete paired opportunities; keep metric denominators and Phase 6 gates independent.

executionOrder: Record the approved successor plan and data-format preimages; update only the authorized planHash and dataFormatHash fields.
Remove semantic verifier outcomes as a source of trial counts or positive utility; preserve verification and review inspection evidence.
Fail closed for canonical mutation unless a distinct, authenticated MeasuredTrialReceipt validates against a frozen proposal and complete paired trial.
Implement and test versioned grant, measured-use, paired-trial, replay, idempotency, expiry, CAS, and recovery contracts without changing core SessionEventMap or public method shapes.
Keep positive trial activation disabled until accountable external evaluator trust, oracle, artifact resolver, and protected candidate-only runtime descriptor are supplied.
Run assembled candidate behavior tests only after a provisioned evaluator is available; compare preregistered baseline/candidate tasks and record failures and unknowns.
Re-run affected package tests, typecheck, doc sync, source/profile/runtime drift, CI, rollback, and Phase 6 audit; do not release or publish without separate authorization.
